Package org.apache.juneau.rest.client.mcp.auth

Class WwwAuthenticateChallenge

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.rest.client.mcp.auth.WwwAuthenticateChallenge
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class WwwAuthenticateChallenge extends Object implements Serializable
A parsed WWW-Authenticate: Bearer ... challenge as returned by an OAuth 2.1 / MCP resource server on a 401/403 response (RFC 6750 §3, RFC 9728 §5.1).

The MCP client uses this to recover the resource_metadata pointer to the RFC 9728 PRM document, the per-operation scope on a step-up challenge, and the error code. Auth-param values are matched case-insensitively on the key per RFC 7235.

Serializable (it is just a scheme string plus an immutable string map) so it can ride along a serialized McpInsufficientScopeException without being dropped.

Since:
10.0.0

  • Method Details

    • parse

      public static Optional<WwwAuthenticateChallenge> parse(String headerValue)
      Parses a single WWW-Authenticate header value.

      Recognizes a single challenge of the form <scheme> <key>=<value>, <key>="<value>", .... Both quoted and bare token values are accepted; commas inside quoted values are preserved.

      Parameters:
      headerValue - The raw header value. May be null or blank.
      Returns:
      The parsed challenge, or Optional.empty() if the value is null/blank or has no scheme token.
